rows.name: synstructure
rows.reason: The gate dates from when proc_macro did not exist on WebAssembly; in blaze's sandbox (wasm32-wasip1) it does, so `extern crate proc_macro`, `decl_derive!` and `decl_attribute!` must not be switched off there.

rows.name: syn
rows.reason: syn 1.x switches its proc_macro surface off on WebAssembly (`Parser::parse`, `parse_macro_input!`'s function, `TokenBuffer::new`, `extern crate proc_macro`); in blaze's sandbox (wasm32-wasip1) proc_macro exists, so quickcheck_macros 1.0.0's `syn::Item::parse.parse(input)` must compile there.
